sloka: एषा ते हृदयं भित्त्वा शक्तिर्लोहितलक्षणा ।मद्बाहुपरिघोत्सृष्टा प्राणानादाय यास्यति ।। ६.१०१.२९ ।।
transliteration: eṣā te hṛdayaṁ bhittvā śaktirlohitalakṣaṇā ।madbāhuparighotsṛṣṭā prāṇānādāya yāsyati ।। 6.101.29 ।।

translations.english: "This javelin released by my bludgeonlike arm will pierce your heart and take away your life."
